modes.label: CPU-only VM, AMD EPYC Genoa (cpu-d3)
modes.note: Non-GPU AMD Epyc Genoa: $0.012 per CPU-hour + $0.0032 per GiB-hour (rates before 2026-10-01; from 2026-10-01 $0.015 + $0.0045). Presets 2vcpu-8gb ... 128vcpu-512gb in all regions, 160-256 vCPU presets outside eu-north1/eu-south1 (1:4 vCPU:GiB). Verified 2026-09-28 at https://docs.nebius.com/compute/resources/pricing and https://docs.nebius.com/compute/virtual-machines/types. Docs say "CPU hour" without defining CPU vs vCPU; presets are named in vCPU, so treated as vCPU. No preemptible rate listed for non-GPU.

modes.note: Non-GPU Intel Ice Lake, eu-north1 only: $0.012 per CPU-hour + $0.0032 per GiB-hour (before 2026-10-01; from 2026-10-01 $0.012 + $0.0045). Presets 2vcpu-8gb ... 80vcpu-320gb (1:4). plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: Self-serve pay-as-you-go account, no platform fee; GPU quota may need a request.

caveats: Use rates BEFORE October 1, 2026. Pricing landing spot floors differ materially from documented preemptible rates: both retained but not conflated. L40S separately bills CPU/RAM; other GPU platform reference bundles include them. Dynamic spot starts October 8, not September 22 announcement date. As of Sep 28 docs fixed preemptible prices still apply.
Any null count, CPU/RAM, billing increment or minimum is unverified, not unlimited/free.
This is GPU-product research, not a claim that every feature of the entire vendor documentation was audited. Unverified features are null.
GPU multi-count bundles, variant/region selection and fractional slices require a SKU-aware estimator; unsupported rows remain unpriced in strict cards.

Modes with gpu=null are intentionally excluded, not free GPU modes. Never substitute 0 for a null rate. Flags alt indicate DIY/ML infrastructure, not the same thing as managed untrusted-code sandboxes.
Unknown fee, storage or bandwidth means full monthly total may be unavailable. Rates exclude taxes.
H100/H200/B200 on-demand prices rise 2026-10-01 to $4.50/$5.40/$8.50 per GPU-h; spot prices are dynamic (from $0.79) and left unpriced.

CPU-only VMs (cpu-d3 AMD Genoa all regions, cpu-e2 Intel Ice Lake eu-north1) added 2026-09-28 at pre-October rates $0.012/vCPU-h + $0.0032/GiB-h; from 2026-10-01 AMD becomes $0.015 + $0.0045 and Intel $0.012 + $0.0045 (nebius.com/prices landing: "from $0.10" -> "from $0.13" AMD, "$0.05" -> "$0.06" Intel). Plain VMs: no sandbox API, disk ($0.071/GiB-month network SSD) billed separately.

Serverless AI (Devlabs, jobs, endpoints: container workloads on Compute VMs) has no own pricing; it bills Compute VM + disk rates and counts toward Compute quotas. A stopped Devlab still pays its whole container disk.

fleet.tiers: Default GPU quotas (regular VMs, per region): H100 32 (eu-north1); H200 32 eu-north1, 8 eu-west1, 0 us-central1; B200 0 (us-central1, me-west1); B300 32 (uk-south1, eu-west2, us-north1); RTX PRO 6000 32 (uk-south2, eu-south1), 0 us-central1; L40S 2 (eu-north1). 12 regular + 8 preemptible GPU VMs per region.
fleet.notes: No single current aggregate GPU quota asserted: historical published per-type allowances are not additive and current project/region quota must be checked. Blog describes quota approval friction; no standard review time.
